reason: The cited evidence (E1–E3) concerns different alloy systems (Mo5, AlCoCuFeNi, AlCoCrFeNi2.1) and does not provide any data on annealing-induced dual-phase formation, ductility improvement, or property retention in HfZrTiTa0.53. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Annealing HfZrTiTa0.53 at ~1000°C induces a refined dual-phase microstructure with ductile grain-boundary regions
Such a dual-phase structure enhances tensile ductility and uniform elongation by at least 20%
The treatment relieves residual stresses and causes phase separation/precipitation at grain boundaries
Yield strength, compressive strength, and impact energy release are preserved within ±10%
The mechanism operates at room temperature under quasi-static loading
